    { "id": "prac-permit-scraping", "text": "Generally, agencies shall permit web scraping and archival services to operate unimpeded without challenge-response restrictions (e.g., without presenting CAPTCHAs).", "as_of_date": "2023-09-22", "scope": "site", "grounding_span": "agencies shall permit web scraping and", "location": "III.A.4" },
    { "id": "prac-no-limit-crawlers", "text": "Agencies must not limit which search engines or crawlers can access or archive their public content.", "as_of_date": "2023-09-22", "scope": "content", "grounding_span": "Agencies must not limit which search engines or crawlers can access or archive their", "location": "III.A.4" },
    { "id": "prac-seo-content", "text": "Agencies should ensure that publicly available content is designed and structured so it can be effectively crawled and indexed by search engines.", "as_of_date": "2023-09-22", "scope": "content", "grounding_span": "so it can be effectively crawled and indexed by search engines", "location": "III.A.4" },
    { "id": "prac-sitemaps-metadata", "text": "Agencies should employ best practices to improve crawling or indexing, including using sitemaps, robots.txt files, and descriptive metadata in commonly parsed fields.", "as_of_date": "2023-09-22", "scope": "content", "grounding_span": "using sitemaps, robots.txt files,29 and descriptive metadata in", "location": "III.A.4" },
    { "id": "prac-timeliness", "text": "Agencies should indicate when content was created or last updated using in-line temporal information, the Last-Modified HTTP header, metadata tags, or XML sitemaps.", "as_of_date": "2023-09-22", "scope": "content", "grounding_span": "by using “Last Modified” in the HTTP header, in metadata tags, or in \nXML sitemaps", "location": "III.A.4" },
    { "id": "prac-bulk-api", "text": "Where there is significant public interest in scraping, agencies should make information available as machine-readable data accessible in bulk and optimized for automated access, such as through an API.", "as_of_date": "2023-09-22", "scope": "bulk_file", "grounding_span": "available as machine-readable data that \ncan be accessed in bulk and optimized for automated access (such as through an API)", "location": "III.A.4" },
    { "id": "prac-standard-interfaces", "text": "Agencies should build and share standardized interfaces (e.g., web APIs with industry-standard exchange formats) to promote interoperability.", "as_of_date": "2023-09-22", "scope": "api", "grounding_span": "standardized interfaces (e.g., web APIs with industry-standard exchange", "location": "III.A.9.b" },
    { "id": "prac-static-site", "text": "Where a website does not require a dynamic back-end, agencies should prefer static website architectures.", "as_of_date": "2023-09-22", "scope": "site", "grounding_span": "agencies should prefer “static” \nwebsite architectures", "location": "III.A.9.b" },
    { "id": "prac-default-html", "text": "When developing information for the web, agencies should default to creating and publishing content in HTML rather than print-oriented formats like PDF or DOCX.", "as_of_date": "2023-09-22", "scope": "content", "grounding_span": "agencies should default to creating and publishing content in an HTML format", "location": "III.A.9.b" },
    { "id": "prac-no-third-party", "text": "Agencies must not embed static, unchanging third-party web assets hosted on services not under the agency's control.", "as_of_date": "2023-09-22", "scope": "site", "grounding_span": "Agencies must not embed static, unchanging \nweb assets", "location": "III.A.5" },
    { "id": "prac-modern-protocols", "text": "Agencies must employ the latest stable versions of HTTP, HTML, and other relevant standards.", "as_of_date": "2023-09-22", "scope": "site", "grounding_span": "agencies must employ the latest stable versions of HTTP", "location": "III.A.8" },
    { "id": "prac-encrypt-https", "text": "Agencies shall encrypt all web traffic as HTTPS and preload registered .gov/.mil domains as HTTPS-only.", "as_of_date": "2023-09-22", "scope": "site", "grounding_span": "encrypt all web traffic across their websites and", "location": "III.A.5" },
    { "id": "prac-open-standards", "text": "Agencies should follow appropriate web standards and be browser neutral rather than designing for a single browser.", "as_of_date": "2023-09-22", "scope": "any", "grounding_span": "agencies should follow appropriate web standards", "location": "III.A.9.b" },
    { "id": "prac-developer-page", "text": "Agencies should maintain a developer page centralizing public web APIs, source code repositories, and technical documentation for external developers.", "as_of_date": "2023-09-22", "scope": "api", "grounding_span": "Agencies should maintain a developer page", "location": "III.A.9.b" },
